description: This source file defines functions for extracting and formatting version information from a provided data structure. It includes methods to parse version data that can be either a list or a string and ensures a standard version format.

methods.name: GetVersion(info)
methods.description: Extracts the version as a list of three integers (major, minor, patch) from provided information, handling different formats and defaulting missing values.

methods.name: GetVersionString(info)
methods.description: Returns the version as a dot-separated string based on the list produced by GetVersion.
